text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelooous☆ Summer Training Camp is Marvelous,
don't you think?★ 
Mister Sun seems happy!
Seems like something good will happen!!

And with that in mind,
we were doing well during 
this year's summer training camp.
However――

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, training camp is fine but……out in the
countryside, 
there aren't too many places to have fun,
huh……

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
You said it~,
I can't help but think……that it might 
be a bit more fun if there were some shops
at least~.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text: Signal's weak too, so I'm really bored……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's Marvelous things all over the place,
you know! 
Like, that beach house!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A tasty,
salt-flavored yakisoba is good too, 
but the inner tubes you can borrow for
free 
as a Tracen Academy student are what I'd
recommend!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If it's now,
then you might be able to see some
tropical 
fish depending on the tides☆ Being able to
just float 
around and find pretty fish is Marvelous
too★

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~, so there are tropical fish, huh~?! 
I kind of want to see them~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then,
if you walk a little bit――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Seems like there's a really pretty stream!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it, that this river has a king! 
If we were able to see it,
it'd be very Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
A king!? If we got a picture of it, 
I bet it'd create quite a buzz!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
See! Marvelous is everywhere all around
us☆

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~,
so there was all that nearby. I had no idea.
During 
our next break, let's go take a look! Thanks,
Marvelous-san!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Rather than being bored, 
going and having fun is Marvelous after
all☆

As usual,
Marvelous Sunday's positive attitude 
was wonderful.
It only took a moment to change 
the other students' outlook to a positive
one.

However, since we're at Summer Training Camp,
I wonder if we 
could find something more special――no,
Marvelous, to enjoy.
choice_data_list: ……I should try to find something too
……I should try to find something too

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong?
Your eyebrows are all scrunched up. 
Worried about something?
choice_data_list: I'm fine. Nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I see☆ …………

And so,
to make the Summer Training Camp more
Marvelous, 
I started searching for something fun
nearby――

I wandered every which way to ask questions
and get information. 
I wanted those girls to have a Marvelous
experience――

As if in response to that feeling,
I had found something.
A festival held once every 5 years 
in the next town.
It was certain to be Marvelous!

I was sure Marvelous Sunday and the others
would 
be overjoyed!
I needed to relay this information 
ASAP so we could make preparations to go!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaiii~! Welcome back☆★☆ 
Everyone here's ready to go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh~ Ahahahaha! 
So this is the Marvelous that Trainer
made☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yep yep! I knew Trainer could do it! 
Because Trainer and me think alike,
after all☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I had everyone start getting
ready~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is Marvelous so, for sure,
you'd find something 
incredibly Marvelous,
is what I told them☆★

『If I hadn't done that,
what would you have done……?』

『If I hadn't done that,
what would you have done……?』

I'm sure the old me would have asked something
like that. 
But weirdly,
those weren't the words that came out.
Instead――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Rather than one person's,
it's both of our Marvelous☆

And so we all head to the next town, 
waiting on the footpath for the festival
floats to come.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah……I think I hear something. 
I wonder if they're here now?

text_block_list.name: Float-bearers
text_block_list.text: Waashoi! Waashoi!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaa! This is great!
It's flashier than I imagined! 
This'll cause a buzz~!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It will! It's Marvelous! 
Marvelous☆ Marvelous★

After that,
we followed the floats in high spirits, 
eventually arriving at the Summer Festival
venue.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
To think the floats would be that heavy!
They let me 
try pulling it but,
doing it by myself was pretty hard~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Being able to move it by yourself is
Marvelous☆ 
Let's see if they'll let us all pull it
together afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
After this,
sounds like they're going to do something 
with fireworks on them! Hand-held fireworks!
I guess 
they're fireworks you carry in your hands
or something~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~ so there's fireworks like that!
Being able to 
hold them in your hands,
it sounds very Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sounds like it's starting soon! 
Let's all go take a look!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaa! Everyone's Marvelous, huh☆ 
More than usual, much much more,
a happy Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
As I thought, rather than with just one person,
with two――
choice_data_list: With two of us it's better――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆★☆

It was easy to make the world sparkle.
Not alone, but together―― 
with just that……the world would become more
Marvelous.

In order to spread Marvelous around the
world, 
I would continue to work together with
her!
